title: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
content: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

title: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
content: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
content: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.

title: The U.S. last held a public execution in the 1930s. The Pentagon wants to change that
content: The Pentagon says it will livestream the firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan at Fort Hood, the site of his 2009 mass shooting. That would be the first public execution in the U.S. since the 1930s.

title: U.S. working to reverse an Egyptian man's third-country deportation to Africa
content: The Trump administration's effort to return Ahmed Soliman to the U.S. come after an Arizona judge said his deportation violated due process.

title: Did Russia play by the rules in reporting lab worker's death?
content: A global treaty signed by 197 countries — including Russia — requires reporting any death that could be a sign of an outbreak to come.

title: How the oil industry is preparing for Hurricane Isaias
content: Hurricane Isaias is this season's first Atlantic hurricane, and is on a path to hit the northern Gulf Coast. How is the oil industry preparing?

title: Trump says U.S. won't attack Iran before midterms. And, ICE agent shoots man in NYC
content: Trump announced that the U.S. will not attack Iran ahead of the midterms. And, a 28-year-old man is receiving treatment at the hospital after an ICE agent shot him in the neck.

title: Why American investors love European defense startups
content: As European defense spending takes off, just about half of the funding in Europe's defense tech industry is coming from American investors this year. One reason why: European investment firms have restrictions on how they can invest.
